Added the engine-opened turn exception to the dismissal rules. Traced: extractLatestTurnTrigger sets latestTurnTrigger from isProviderTriggeredTurn on the newest turn.started; buildHomeWorkItems sets engineOpenedTurn from openTurn.trigger while open, else latestTurnTrigger; isInboxDismissed keeps a dismissal through quiet lifecycles (Running, Current, Ready, Recent, Completed) for such turns, while Failed/Stopped/Needs attention/Unanswerable, an attention change or a person's turn still revive it. Covered by inbox-dismissal and home-view-model tests with fault injection.
